title: Skip sleep in GTA 6 and it shows on your face (story, silent preview)
hook_options: Skip sleep in GTA 6 and it shows on your face.
Overeat in GTA 6 and your character gains weight.
GTA 6 writes your worst habits on your face.
hook_pick: Option 1: everyone skips sleep (launch night most of all), the face is instantly visual, it is new (San Andreas never tracked sleep) and it is checkable in Dazed. Option 2 is old news to San Andreas fans; option 3 is vaguer.
ending: one line question, then the loop line 'Just remember.' that runs into the hook on replay, then the noticed. end card

beats.say: Skip sleep in GTA Six and it shows on your face.

caps.text: Skip sleep in GTA 6 / and it shows / on your face.

beats.say: That's from Dazed's deep dive with Rockstar. And your face is just the start.

caps.text: That's from Dazed's / deep dive with Rockstar.
And your face / is just the start.

beats.say: Food changes Jason and Lucia's weight. Rockstar's own demo: an apple, a smoothie, health up for a while. Overeat, and the weight goes on.

paper.label: REPORTED
paper.head: Food affects Jason and Lucia's weight

paper.label: ROCKSTAR SAYS
paper.quote: Here I am eating an apple, opening the fridge and drinking a smoothie. So this will increase my health temporarily for a while...
paper.source: Rob Nelson, Rockstar North, to The New York Times

caps.text: Overeat, and / the weight goes on.

beats.footnote: REPORTED: Dazed; IGN interview. ROCKSTAR SAYS: NYT.

beats.say: The gym visibly builds muscle. Look at Rockstar's footage: L two, R two. Press in rhythm, or burn stamina.

caps.text: Look at Rockstar's footage: / L2, R2.
Press in rhythm, / or burn stamina.

beats.footnote: FOOTAGE: ROCKSTAR GAMES. REPORTED: Dazed; NYT.

beats.say: Now the twist. Stay away from bed too long, on the run or on a bender for days, and their faces pay for it.

caps.text: Stay away from bed / too long,
on the run, or on / a bender for days,
and their faces / pay for it.

beats.footnote: REPORTED: Dazed, after interviews with Rockstar.

beats.say: Dazed compared it to Dorian Gray.

paper.label: DAZED SAYS
paper.head: A bit like The Picture of Dorian Gray

beats.say: Your habits, written on their faces.

caps.text: Your habits, written / on their faces.

beats.say: San Andreas did weight and muscle in two thousand four. GTA Four and Five dropped it. Twenty two years later, it's back.
beats.footnote: REPORTED: Eurogamer. 22 YEARS: OUR MATH, 2004 to 2026.

beats.say: Rob Nelson's hope? You get up, have a coffee, shower, and go out for a little exercise. In the game.

chip.text: ROB NELSON, CO STUDIO HEAD, ROCKSTAR NORTH

paper.label: ROCKSTAR SAYS
paper.quote: I hope that there will be people that want to get up, have a cup of coffee, shower, get dressed, go out for a little exercise
paper.source: Rob Nelson to The New York Times

beats.say: So how many hours are you sleeping on launch night?

caps.text: So how many hours / are you sleeping / on launch night?
